common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Familiar desktop pet animation sprite strip. Input image is EXACT character identity reference; preserve its face, silhouette, proportions, palette, line thickness and rendering. ONE horizontal strip with COUNT equally spaced full-body frames, equal-sized canvases, same character scale and ground baseline across frames and strips. ACTION Pure solid bright cyan #00FFFF contrasting background for chroma key, no gradients/shadows. Generous spacing and outer margins, every body part fully visible, feet at bottom. No text, labels, grid, scene, speed lines, sweat, stars, props or detached effects. Wide landscape strip. Keep character size consistent between all action strips: head-to-feet neutral height 320 pixels on a 2048x683 canvas; sleeping naturally lower. Use exactly this canvas 2048x683 for six frames.

idle: IDLE calibration: same neutral upright standing pose as reference, tiny breathing and blink. This is the scale ruler; preserve reference body proportions.
listening: LISTENING loop: upright attentive, ears perked, subtle head tilt and blink, tiny breathing, return to start.
talking: TALKING loop: upright speaking, mouth opens and closes through six distinct phases, gentle head bob, return to start.
sleeping: SLEEPING loop: eyes peacefully closed, curled/resting low body, slow tiny breathing, no Z letters.
petted: PETTED one-shot: respond to an invisible head stroke, slight head dip, closed happy eyes, content smile, lean gently then recover; no human hand.
poked: POKED one-shot: surprised small recoil, squeezed eyes then briefly annoyed cheeks, settle back; no finger or human hand.
worried: WORRIED loop: concerned lowered ears, eyebrows raised inward, paws close to chest, subtle anxious glance and blink; no sweat or symbols.
peeking: PEEKING loop: strict LEFT-FACING THREE-QUARTER SIDE VIEW. Snout protrudes to the LEFT, both eyes gaze strongly LEFT, far eye foreshortened. Full body leans a little LEFT, head tilts, ONE PAW reaches LEFT as if holding an invisible wall edge. Do not draw wall. Entire pet centered, feet baseline, leftmost 40% includes face. Six phases tiny peek and blink, no big translation. Never a front-facing portrait.
happy: Happy mood idle: crescent smile, tiny sway and tail wag.
curious: Curious mood idle: head tilt, attentive eyes, perked ears, tiny glances.
drowsy: Drowsy mood idle: half-closed eyes, gentle yawn and nod, still awake.

notes: Dango's initial six states used the same spec without the final canvas-size sentence; its peeking was redrawn using the stricter left-facing action above. A separate generated idle strip calibrated each pet; generated source rows were normalized as whole strips before packing. Final images were chroma-keyed to transparent RGBA, packed losslessly.
